label: Bruiser
notes: The Bruiser (M6 HEAVIES), 2.05 m, procedural fists. Ratchets are today's figure plus a few tenths, the plan's bars still printed as GATE; a ratchet only moves down. a6.legs 0.895: the concept's baggy cargo trousers over knee pads against a leg capsule of r 0.1 x 1.139 (the torso, 99%, and the head, 97%, meet the 95% bar after the girth clamps; the legs hold at 90% with thigh/shin clamps of 0.085/0.075 m: the Punk's 0.078/0.068 would make the trousers read as sticks under a 1 m wide jacket). a9_cells and a9_lens_pp: the art is a padded jacket, plates and guards, far bulkier than the primitive body that the proxies are (at 1 m the smash, grab and headbutt fill 65-88% of the view against the proxies' 60-82%): the lens share and the cells that differ are the heavy's bulk, not a misplacement; a9_strike_art_share_min is the twin (the art itself keeps 35% of the view). anchor_m: the flash anchor is clamped onto the nearest bone's follower, 3.4 cm at the helmet and 2.8 cm at the thigh at 2.05 m (the plan's 2 cm at 1.8 m scales to 2.3). stretch_m 0.145: the jacket's hem and hips (a long triangle of the decimated back) in the overhead smash's lunge; the Punk's is 0.09. FB-DETAIL (the detail pilot: no border relax, crease ink) moved three ratchets UP by a few tenths of a point, old -> new: bruiser_smash pitch +8 lens gap 0.188 -> 0.192 (measured 0.189), bruiser_grab pitch +8 0.152 -> 0.156 (0.152), leg flash anchor 0.029 -> 0.032 m (0.031); the strain file's whole low_min 0.169 -> 0.160 (0.1653), every other whole-run figure kept.
